title: 간접 화법
label: TOPIC 15. 화법
subtitle: (1) 평서문 (2) 의문문 (3) 명령문 (4) 감탄문 · 기원문의 화법 전환

items.en: Rick says that he'll be back soon.
Tom said that Jim was sick.

fix.why: 짝인 직접화법의 said 뒤 쉼표가 빠졌고 여는 따옴표 뒤에 빈칸이 있었습니다.

items.en: He asked me if my mother was in.
items.ko: 그는 나에게 우리 어머니가 집에 계신지 물었다.
items.promptEn: He said to me, "Is your mother in?"

fix.from: He said to me ,”Is your mother in?”
fix.why: 짝인 직접화법의 쉼표 앞 빈칸과 여는 따옴표 모양(”)을 고쳤습니다.

items.en: He asked me what I was doing.
items.ko: 그는 나에게 내가 무엇을 하고 있는지 물었다.
items.promptEn: He said to me, "What are you doing?"

fix.from: He said to me, “ What are you doing?”
fix.why: 짝인 직접화법의 여는 따옴표 뒤 빈칸을 없앴습니다.

items.en: The doctor told me to stay in bed for a few days.
items.ko: 의사는 나에게 며칠 동안 침대에 누워 있으라고 말했다.
items.promptEn: "Stay in bed for a few days," the doctor said to me.

fix.from: The doctor told me to stay in bed. / “ Stay in bed for a few days,” the doctor said to me.
fix.why: 직접화법의 for a few days 가 간접화법에서 빠져 있었습니다. 화법을 바꿀 때 내용을 빠뜨리면 안 되므로 넣었습니다(짝인 직접화법의 따옴표 뒤 빈칸도 없앰).

items.en: Bill suggested going to the movies.
items.promptEn: Bill said, "Let's go to the movies."

items.en: He said that it was a really great movie.
items.ko: 그는 그것이 정말 대단한 영화라고 말했다.
items.promptEn: He said, "What a great movie it is!"

fix.from: He said that it was a very great movie. / He said, “What a great movie it is!
fix.why: great(대단한)는 very 와 잘 어울리지 않아 really great 로 고쳤습니다(교재 답도 허용 답에 둠). 짝인 직접화법에 빠진 닫는 따옴표도 넣었습니다.

items.en: She prayed that God might bless me.
items.ko: 그녀는 신이 나를 축복해 주시기를 기도했다.

discovery.question: 직접화법을 간접화법으로 바꾸면 따옴표 안의 말은 어떻게 될까요?
options: 전하는 사람의 입장에 맞게 인칭 · 시제가 바뀐다
따옴표만 없어지고 낱말은 그대로다
전달 동사가 문장 끝으로 간다
discovery.why: I'll → he'll, is → was, are you doing → I was doing 처럼 전하는 사람의 입장에 맞게 인칭과 시제가 바뀌어요.

blocks.title: 간접화법: 한 말을 전하는 사람의 입장에서 바꿔 전합니다
points: 평서문: said to me → told me, 따옴표 대신 that + 주어 + 동사
인칭은 전하는 입장으로 바꿔요(I → he · she, you → me).
전달 동사가 과거면 안의 시제를 한 걸음 과거 쪽으로(is → was, has → had).
의문문: ask + if(의문사 없을 때) 또는 의문사 + 주어 + 동사
명령문: tell · ask · advise + 목적어 + (not) to + 동사원형

rows: Tom said that Jim was sick.
He said to me, "What are you doing?"
He asked me what I was doing.
"Stay in bed for a few days," the doctor said to me.
The doctor told me to stay in bed for a few days.
Bill said, "Let's go to the movies."
Bill suggested going to the movies.
He said, "What a great movie it is!"
He said that it was a really great movie.
She cried with delight that she had won.
She prayed that God might bless me.

blocks.koDiff: 우리말은 “아파.”를 '아프다고 말했다'처럼 '-다고 · -냐고 · -라고'로 전하고 안의 시제는 그대로 두지만, 영어는 전달 동사가 과거(said)면 안의 동사도 한 걸음 과거 쪽으로 옮겨요(is → was). 전달 동사가 현재(says)면 그대로 두고, 늘 참인 사실은 said 뒤에서도 현재로 둘 수 있어요.

mistakes.wrong: He asked me what was I doing.
mistakes.right: He asked me what I was doing.

mistakes.wrong: She said me that she was busy.
mistakes.right: She told me that she was busy.
mistakes.why: said 뒤에 바로 me 를 쓰지 않아요. said to me 는 told me 로 바꿔요.

worked: She said to me, "I am hungry."
said to me → told me, 따옴표 대신 that
She told me that she was hungry.

check.question: 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은? He said to me, "I will help you."
options: He told me that he would help me.
He told me that I will help you.
He told me that he will help you.
check.why: I → he, you → me 로 인칭을 바꾸고, said 가 과거라 will → would 로 써요.

select.instruction: 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 밑줄 친 said to me 는 보통 무엇이 되나요?
select.sentence: He said to me, "I like pizza."
options: told me
asked me
said me
select.why: 평서문을 전할 때 said to me 는 told me 로 바꿔요: He told me that he liked pizza.

select.instruction: 의문사가 없는 질문을 간접화법으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
select.sentence: She said to me, "Are you hungry?" → She asked me ___ I was hungry.
options: if
that
what
select.why: yes · no 로 답하는 질문은 if(또는 whether)로 '~인지'를 전해요.

select.instruction: He said to me, "Where do you live?"를 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
options: He asked me where I lived.
He asked me where did I live.
He asked me where do I live.
select.why: 간접의문문은 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 순서이고, asked 가 과거라 live → lived 예요.
직접화법의 is 가 전달 동사 said(과거)에 맞춰 was 로 바뀌었어요.

select.instruction: The teacher said to us, "Open your books."를 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
options: The teacher told us to open our books.
The teacher told us that open our books.
The teacher said us open your books.
select.why: 명령문은 told + 목적어 + to + 동사원형으로 전하고, your 는 전하는 입장(우리)에 맞춰 our 로 바꿔요.

select.instruction: Mom said to me, "Don't run."을 간접화법으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
options: Mom told me not to run.
Mom told me to run.
Mom told me don't run.
select.why: 부정 명령문은 not + to + 동사원형으로 전해요.

select.instruction: 간접화법에서 빈칸에 알맞은 한 낱말을 쓰세요
select.sentence: She said, "I will call you." → She said that she ___ call me.
select.why: 전달 동사 said 가 과거라 will 은 would 로 바꿔요.
